summary: Author's MongoDB Atlas credential shipped in tarball.env
details: The published tarball includes a.env file containing a MongoDB Atlas SRV connection string with an embedded username and password for a cluster owned by the package author (cluster0.jwhwhf1.mongodb.net). The credential is inert in the tarball: no lifecycle scripts execute, no installer data is read, and no network calls are made to attacker-controlled hosts. The exposed credential authorizes access only to the author's own database and does not provide any mechanism through which an installer of this package is attacked or has their data redirected.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
